evidence_level: vendor-reported (Pathway research page, Aug 11 2026) + independent latent-reasoning literature
note: Clearly labeled precomputed results, not live model behaviour.

bdh_cq.comparison: GPT Luna 5.6 Low: 34.2% at ~11x the cost
bdh_cq.mechanism: iterative computation in a recurrent latent state; decodes only candidate answers; no chain-of-thought tokens; no per-task retraining

coconut.finding: Continuous-thought (Coconut) outperforms CoT on planning-heavy logical reasoning with a better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff; latent states enable breadth-first search over alternatives instead of committing to one deterministic path.

cot.finding: Chain-of-thought prompting (intermediate steps as words) unlocks reasoning in large LMs; e.g. 540B model + 8 CoT exemplars reached SOTA on GSM8K.
